Implement comprehensive ATS parser, 3-pillar scoring engine (Keyword Match 45%, ATS Parseability 25%, Content Quality 30%), AI insights, full grounded Resume Optimizer, history in MongoDB, analytics dashboard, DOCX and PDF export

universal_guidelines: Never use full transparent headers without blur or solid background
Use pill badges, bold sans-serif headings, white rounded cards
Always set explicit hover and focus text colors
Include data-testid on all buttons, links, inputs, and score cards
